Lucky Pocket

Common perk · Scoring bonus

A scoring play made immediately after drawing adds 5 points.

In-game card text

How it works

Your first play after a trip to the boneyard gains +5 points for each copy if it scores.

  • It works whether you play the bone you just drew or another one.
  • If the drawn bone cannot play, your turn passes, and the bonus waits for your next play.
  • Using a Table Pass also counts as a trip for this perk.
  • Any play clears the bonus, scoring or not, so only that one play can earn it.

At a glance

RarityCommon
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 120 Bone Bucks.
